data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 was GBP 121.331m. During 2015 the syndicate experienced an adverse prior accident year run-off deviation of GBP 0.5m, wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2012 Whole Account Quota Share contract with Syndicate 2003, resulting in a small net strengthening of prior year reserves. The movement is described as an adverse run-off deviation and therefore reflects adverse claims development related to reinsurance arrangements (WQS).

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet liabilities 'Claims outstanding' 2014 comparative column (GBP 121,331k). Prior year development (GBP 0.5m adverse run-off deviation) taken from Note 9 which explicitly states the GBP 0.5m; the note appears to describe this as the prior-year (2012) movement - treated as a gross strengthening. A gross claims development triangle (gross, in GBP 000s) is present on page 27 and was used to cross-check but the explicit movement note was used as primary. No line-by-line LOB prior-year movement amounts are provided in the notes, so lob_movements is empty.
